Secret Service smoked brisket sliders.veg: Two years with Carter and four with Reagan. Smoky mushrooms, pickles and hot mustard on milk buns.

Katana-cut seared tuna with ponzu.veg: Frank's sword slices Rachel's scarf in two. Sesame-crusted tofu, ponzu and spring onion.

Miami benefit snapper with mango salsa.veg: Rachel meets Portman at the Miami party. Grilled haloumi, mango salsa and coconut rice.

Herb Farmer's lake cabin beef pot pie.veg: Hiding out at Herb's cabin on the lake. Mushrooms, lentils and thyme under flaky pastry.

The bodyguard's orange juice, straight o.af: Frank asks for orange juice on the job. Blood orange juice and soda, the way Frank takes it.
